title: Buttermilk Biscuits
description: Buttermilk Biscuits is a dish from United States prepared with all-purpose flour, baking powder, buttermilk. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Gently fold in the remaining dry or wet ingredients just until homogeneous, without deflating the mixture.
Shape, press or roll the prepared dough or mixture into portions appropriate to this dish.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 17 minutes until set and cooked through.
